data.name: Acolyte's Fall
data.detailed_description:
The realm is dying, and the gods have gone silent. You are an acolyte cast down into the ruin — one more soul among the fallen. Rise, blade in hand, and carve a path through a merciless dark-fantasy world that wants you dead.

Deliberate, punishing combat

Every strike matters. Manage your stamina, break your enemy's poise, and choose your moments — roll through a flurry, then punish the opening. Time a perfect parry to stagger a foe and drive home a devastating riposte, or slip behind the unwary for a lethal backstab. There are no cheap victories here, only earned ones.

Forge your own build

Level your character across vigor, endurance, strength, dexterity, intelligence and faith. Wield everything from crushing greatswords to swift blades, master weapon arts and special skills, and weave in spells and incantations. Upgrade your arsenal and reshape your playstyle as the world grows deadlier.

Fall together — online co-op

Face the dark alone, or bring a friend into your world through Steam. Guard each other's backs against roaming horrors, coordinate against towering bosses, and share every hard-won triumph — and every brutal death.

A world that remembers

Rest at ancient shrines to heal, level up and refill your flasks — but every rest revives the enemies you cut down. Fall in battle and you'll drop what you've earned; return to reclaim it, if you can survive the road back. Explore ruined halls, hidden paths and firelit sanctuaries, and face guardians that test everything you've learned.

Features

[*] Methodical Souls-like combat: stamina, poise, dodging, blocking, lock-on, parry & riposte, backstabs

[*] Deep character building: stats, leveling, spells, and weapon upgrades

[*] Online co-op with friends via Steam

[*] Challenging boss encounters

[*] Rest points, respawning enemies, and a persistent death-and-recovery loop

[*] A grim, atmospheric dark-fantasy world to explore

The gods won't save you. Rise anyway.

data.short_description: Acolyte's Fall is a dark-fantasy Souls-like of deliberate, punishing combat. Master stamina, poise, parries and weapon arts, forge your build across spell and steel, and topple towering bosses. Rest at ancient shrines, die, rise again—then summon a friend to fall beside you.

Its a fantasy RPG game with slaying of Skeletons, Humans and animals. 

There is no excessive use of blood or gore. Very small blood particles showing on hits with certain weapons.
